title: Herbal Chicken and Veggie Bowl
description: A light and refreshing Chinese-inspired bowl filled with herbal flavors and a hint of tanginess. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package instructions.
Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a pan, heat herbal sauce over medium heat.
Add mixed veggies to the pan and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-5 minutes.
Slice cooked chicken and add to the pan with veggies.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve over brown rice in a bowl.
